name: round-1998
title: fix-round #1998 — a feature round: 12 PRs, each on its own port

cases.title: 2-D: two altitudes paired with their sides «בהתאמה»
lines: OD ו-BE הם גבהים לצלעות BC ו-OC בהתאמה
cases.lookFor: The altitude from O lands on BC at D and the one from B lands on OC at E; both rows green.
cases.before: The second line goes to the AI fallback.

cases.title: 2-D: two medians paired with their sides «בהתאמה»
lines: AD ו-BE הם תיכונים לצלעות BC ו-AC בהתאמה
cases.lookFor: D is the midpoint of BC and E the midpoint of AC, with AD and BE drawn; green.
cases.before: The second line goes to the AI fallback.

cases.title: 2-D: the exam framing «המרובע ABCD הוא טרפז (AB ∥ CD)»
cases.lookFor: A trapezoid with AB ∥ CD, one row, green.
cases.before: Refused, asking to split the line.

cases.title: 2-D: the exam's figure intro and «O – מרכז המעגל»
cases.lookFor: Triangle ABC, its circumcircle, and the centre labelled O; every row green.
cases.before: Lines 1 and 3 go to the AI fallback.

cases.title: 2-D: «המרובע ABCO הוא טרפז ישר זווית»
lines: המרובע ABCO הוא טרפז ישר זווית
cases.lookFor: A right trapezoid ABCO with its right-angle marks.

cases.title: 2-D: a list of the sides a circle touches draws the incircle
lines: הצלעות AB, BC ו-CA משיקות למעגל בנקודות D, E ו-F בהתאמה
cases.lookFor: The inscribed circle of ABC touching AB at D, BC at E and CA at F; green.
cases.before: Refused with «נראה שיש כאן כמה הוראות בשורה אחת…».

cases.title: 2-D: the touch list typed first, then the centre named
lines: הצלעות AB, BC ו-CA משיקות למעגל בנקודות D, E ו-F בהתאמה
cases.lookFor: The same figure as T6, with the centre labelled O.

cases.title: 2-D: a square's touch list draws its incircle
lines: הצלעות AB, BC, CD ו-DA משיקות למעגל בנקודות P, Q, R ו-S בהתאמה
cases.lookFor: The square's inscribed circle touching at P, Q, R, S.

cases.title: REFUSAL — 2-D: a pentagon's touch list says the tool cannot draw it yet
lines: הצלעות AB, BC, CD, DE ו-EA משיקות למעגל
cases.lookFor: The second line is refused with «הכלי עדיין לא יודע לשרטט מעגל חסום במחומש».
cases.before: Refused with the «כמה הוראות» note instead.

cases.title: 2-D: a sector's area as a given
cases.lookFor: The sector resizes with its angle kept, and «12π» sits inside the wedge; green.

cases.title: 2-D: an arc length added to the sector area
cases.lookFor: The angle becomes 120° and «4π» labels the arc; green.

cases.title: 2-D: a sector's area as a quarter of the circle
lines: שטח הגזרה AOB = ¼ משטח המעגל
cases.lookFor: A 90° wedge, and «הציגו תצורה אחרת» keeps it at 90°.

cases.title: 2-D: the sector's area named S
cases.lookFor: S inside the sector; the figure does not change.

cases.title: REFUSAL — 2-D: the English arc length on a bare circle is no longer a chord
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused as unreadable («לא הצלחתי לקרוא את זה עדיין…» — this port has no AI model); no chord AB is drawn and no 4π appears.
cases.before: Commits the CHORD AB = 4π — a straight segment, not the arc.

cases.title: Analytic: «האלכסון AC = 8» on a parallelogram
cases.lookFor: The diagonal AC drawn and labelled 8.

cases.title: Analytic: «התיכון AM = 5»
cases.lookFor: M is the midpoint of BC and AM is labelled 5.

cases.title: Analytic: «גובה הטרפז 4»
cases.lookFor: A height from D to a new point H on AB, labelled 4.

cases.title: Analytic: «גובה המשולש 4» asks which height
cases.lookFor: «גובה המשולש 4» asks: «ל"גובה" כאן יש כמה אפשרויות (הגובה לצלע BC 4, …)», naming the three heights. Then typing the taught «הגובה לצלע BC 4» commits the height to BC, labelled 4.

cases.title: REFUSAL — Analytic: «האלכסון AB = 8» on a parallelogram (AB is a side)
cases.lookFor: Refused, saying AB is a side, not a diagonal. Nothing is drawn as 8.
cases.before: Not understood. (A bare «האלכסון AB» used to draw the side silently — that now refuses too.)

cases.title: Analytic: «משוואת הבסיס» on an isosceles triangle
cases.lookFor: B and C on the line x − 2y + 6 = 0.
cases.before: The last line is not understood.

cases.title: Analytic: the base equation with the equal pair unstated
cases.lookFor: One side lies on the line; «הציגו תצורה אחרת» cycles which side is the base, together with the apex.

cases.title: REFUSAL — Analytic: a parallelogram has no base
cases.lookFor: Refused, quoting the sentence.

cases.title: Analytic: an isosceles triangle says which pair the tool drew
cases.lookFor: A note under the row naming the pair drawn («…כרגע מצוירות AB = AC…») and the amber cue beside «הציגו תצורה אחרת»; pressing it changes the drawing and the named pair together; typing «AC=AB» makes the note and the cue go.

cases.title: Analytic: an isosceles trapezoid says which pair is parallel
cases.lookFor: «הכלי הניח ש-AB ∥ DC (השוקיים AD, BC)…» until «BC מקביל ל-AD» is typed; then the note goes.

cases.title: Analytic: an obtuse triangle, then «זווית A קהה» is read
cases.lookFor: «הכלי לא יודע איזו זווית קהה — כרגע מצוירת ∠…», then «זווית A קהה» records, A is drawn obtuse and the note goes.
cases.before: No note, and «זווית A קהה» is refused.

cases.title: Analytic: the triangle's vertices on the axes
cases.lookFor: A note saying which vertex the tool put on which axis.

cases.title: Complex: an angle in radians, «2cis(π/4)»
cases.lookFor: z₁ at 45° on radius 2, reading «z₁ = 2·cis45°».

cases.title: Complex: the trig form in radians
cases.lookFor: The same point and reading as T27; the row stays as typed.

cases.title: Complex: «2cis(pi)» is 180°, not a free direction
cases.lookFor: z₁ at −2, reading «2·cis180°».
cases.before: Accepted, but «pi» was read as a free direction (a letter), so no angle was stated.

cases.title: REFUSAL — Complex: «z1 = π» as a value is still refused
cases.lookFor: «לא הצלחתי להבין», unchanged.

cases.title: Complex: a computed number shows only its letter on the canvas
cases.lookFor: The canvas shows «w» alone (both views); the panel still has −4+3i.

cases.title: Complex: «z₂ = 18r» stays as typed
cases.lookFor: The canvas reads «z₂ = 18r» in both views; the panel shows r = ±5/9.

cases.title: Complex: a letter's value can be shown or hidden on the canvas
cases.lookFor: The canvas reads «z₁ = 3+bi» and the «a = 3» row has an «a» chip; clicking it turns the canvas to «z₁ = a+bi», and the choice survives «הציגו תצורה אחרת».
cases.before: No chip; the polar view shows a bare «z₁».

cases.title: Complex: the roots of «z^2 = 2i» show their letters only
cases.lookFor: The canvas shows «z₁» and «z₂» alone; their values are in the panel.

cases.title: 2-D: a pasted two-sentence paragraph becomes two rows
cases.lookFor: Two rows («משולש ABC», «M אמצע BC»), the input box empty.
cases.before: The whole line goes to the AI fallback.

cases.title: Analytic: a paste stops at the first sentence that needs a second look
lines: מעבירים אנך מהנקודה P לישר AB. האנך חותך את הישר y = 7 בנקודה C.
cases.lookFor: No row is added yet; the box holds «אנך מהנקודה P לישר AB. האנך חותך…» for a second Enter, which then adds two rows with C on y = 7.
cases.before: The whole paste is not understood.

cases.title: 3-D: a paste stops at a sentence the tool cannot read and keeps the rest
lines: משולש ABC. שלום לכולם. M אמצע BC.
cases.lookFor: One row («משולש ABC»); the box keeps «שלום לכולם. M אמצע BC.» with the refusal for «שלום לכולם».
cases.before: The whole line is not understood.

cases.title: Complex: a paste with decimals splits only at sentence ends
cases.lookFor: Two rows, z = 2.5 + i and w = 1 − i (the decimal point is not a sentence end).

cases.title: 2-D: two possible lengths shown with «או»
cases.lookFor: «AC = 1.45 או AC = 6.21»; and «∠ABC = 13.46 או ∠ABC = 86.54» in degrees.
cases.before: Only the three stated values, and «undetermined» for AC.

cases.title: Complex: a solution-set question lists both values
3-D: two parameter values joined by «או»
lines: המרחק בין המישורים π1 ו-π2 הוא 3

cases.title: Analytic: «הורידו שאלה» exports the givens as a .docx
cases.lookFor: A «הורידו שאלה» button between «הורידו תמונה» and «מדריך». The .docx lists exactly «משולש ABC», «D על BC», «זווית BAD = 30», each as typed (no tidier form yet); the bare «AD» and «E על AB» are left out.

cases.title: Complex: «הורידו שאלה» leaves out checked claims
cases.lookFor: The .docx lists «z1 = 3+4i» and «|z2| = 5», without «w מדומה טהור».

cases.title: Complex: «הורידו שאלה» is greyed out when only a claim is on the canvas
cases.lookFor: «הורידו שאלה» is disabled.
